acceptanceCriteria: Allow HANDOFF and REVIEW_RETURNED across an unrelated reservedFor change only when audited claim policy/config, acceptance, current allocation and member definition remain safely bound; retain complete historical journal evidence.

Refuse changed budgets, retries, gate definitions or required gates, roles/authority, capacity, runtime/environment, allocated member reservation/config/definition, or unknown/missing/corrupt policy evidence; no clean disposition on refusal.

Retain existing current-generation, unexpired lease, clean-accounting, candidate or explicit no-tree eligibility, replay/conflict, reservation release and pool quarantine semantics; no stale-holder reaping or retry refund.

Retain current-source red/green qualification with raw CLI output and independent review, then exact-head dogfood/CEM, required checks and integration; complete through native supported writes only after acceptance evidence and merge.
body: Owning issue: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/482. Official issue observed 2026-10-02. Existing #421 ticket V1-0603 documented whole-policy fencing but does not own this new unrelated-policy compatibility request; STALE_POLICY/unrelated policy/github482 dedup found no owning ticket. Pinned source 1fda1b94984245d0cd0ac0a6d17cc72572ce6619: transaction/lease_handoff.go verifyHandoff compares whole policy hash; transaction/model.go permits unrelated changes while checking occupied MemberDefinition. Requested safety boundary is a release-only historical-policy compatibility check, initially allowing only policyVersion and reservedFor differences on unallocated members; broader precision is not assumed. Preliminary disposable proof /private/tmp/corvint-482-proof/summary.json: Tasks PATH build202 hash 4247bab237b4279fdc3d0f243da7dbe0fa1e4278a1cc52422c130bab5b51ae6a permits policy v1→v2 reservation update while scoped review candidate remains BUILT/ALLOCATED; reap refuses ATTEMPT_LIVE; audit CONSISTENT/AGREES. Installed writer rejects HANDOFF as unknown closed reason, and evidence form as lease-shape MALFORMED despite help exposing reason. Therefore STALE_POLICY red via current installed executable is NOT_PRODUCED, not mislabeled as a reproduction; initial malformed probes retained under /private/tmp/corvint-482-proof-unsupported-evidence. Source-level current tree directly explains reported refusal. No product-source implementation, live policy update, claim, enrollment or gate executed. Independent root admission and supported current-source disposable qualification remain pending. Core163 available official rc.1; Tasks202 available tasks-dev-20260929.2 release evidence only; no broad qualification or publisher verification inferred. Actor authentication, holder liveness and native runtime qualification NOT_OBSERVED. Follow private Gate A proposal /private/tmp/corvint-482-gate-a-proposal.md. Primary commit/stage/checkout/build hold preserved; filing is a supported native write after explicit maintenance release.
title: GH #482: unrelated policy reservations fence clean HANDOFF releases and strand pool allocations
